edges.reason: msg.sender is used in the constructor to mint the initial supply.
_transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender address.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the sender to _transfer.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as spender for the allowance deduction.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
setTrading is restricted by onlyOwner which compares _msgSender() to _owner.
manualswap authorization depends on msg.sender equalling dev or marketing address.
manualsend authorization depends on msg.sender equalling dev or marketing address.
blockBots is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier using _msgSender().
unblockBot is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier using _msgSender().
setFee is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier using _msgSender().
setMaxTxnAmount is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier using _msgSender().
setMaxWalletSize is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier using _msgSender().
setMinSwapTokensThreshold is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier using _msgSender().
toggleSwap is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier using _msgSender().
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier using _msgSender().
block.timestamp is consumed inside swapTokensForEth when building the router call.
block.timestamp is passed directly as the swap deadline, making the call timestamp dependent.
_transfer reads owner() to bypass trading and fee restrictions.
setTrading requires _owner equality via the onlyOwner modifier.
blockBots requires _owner equality via the onlyOwner modifier.
unblockBot requires _owner equality via the onlyOwner modifier.
setFee requires _owner equality via the onlyOwner modifier.
setMaxTxnAmount requires _owner equality via the onlyOwner modifier.
setMaxWalletSize requires _owner equality via the onlyOwner modifier.
setMinSwapTokensThreshold requires _owner equality via the onlyOwner modifier.
toggleSwap requires _owner equality via the onlyOwner modifier.
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees requires _owner equality via the onlyOwner modifier.
_transferStandard reads and writes _rOwned for sender and recipient.
balanceOf converts the caller reflection balance from _rOwned.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide whether a fee applies.
_reflectFee decreases _rTotal during _transferStandard.
_transfer compares block.number against launchBlock for the sniper-bot guard.
_transfer selects and applies the active redis and tax fee values.
_transfer checks the bots blacklist for sender and recipient.
swapTokensForEth uses the stored uniswapV2Router to perform the swap.
The router address receives the external swap call.
_transfer compares from/to with uniswapV2Pair to classify buys and sells.
_transfer reads tradingOpen to restrict transfers before launch.
_transfer enforces _maxTxAmount and caps the swap amount with it.
setTrading writes the current block number into launchBlock.
setTrading writes the tradingOpen flag.
blockBots sets entries of the bots mapping to true.
unblockBot sets a bots mapping entry to false.
setFee updates the redis and tax fee configuration variables.
setMaxTxnAmount writes _maxTxAmount.
setMaxWalletSize writes _maxWalletSize.
setMinSwapTokensThreshold writes _swapTokensAtAmount.
toggleSwap writes the swapEnabled flag.
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees writes _isExcludedFromFee entries.
approve writes the caller allowance into _allowances.
transferFrom updates the allowance mapping after the transfer.
The from parameter drives the transfer checks inside _transfer.
The to parameter drives the transfer checks inside _transfer.
The amount parameter is validated and forwarded inside _transfer.
tAmount is converted into reflection values in _transferStandard.
tokenAmount is swapped through the router in swapTokensForEth.
amount is split between the two fee receivers in sendETHToFee.
The bots_ array is iterated to blacklist addresses.
notbot is written into the bots mapping.
maxTxAmount becomes the new transaction limit.
maxWalletSize becomes the new wallet limit.
accounts array entries are written into the fee exclusion mapping.
recipient is forwarded to _transfer by the public transfer.
amount is forwarded to _transfer by the public transfer.
contractTokenBalance decides the auto-swap branch inside _transfer.
path array is populated and passed to the router swap.
contractETHBalance gates the sendETHToFee call inside _transfer.
_transfer calls _tokenTransfer to apply the token movement.
_transfer conditionally calls swapTokensForEth for auto liquidity conversion.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee which performs external ETH transfers mid-execution.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to execute the transfer.
swapTokensForEth executes the external router swap call.
sendETHToFee performs external ETH transfers to dev and marketing addresses.
manualswap invokes swapTokensForEth with the contract balance.
manualsend invokes sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
Public transfer delegates to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer.
The external router call can reenter the contract before _transfer finishes its state updates.
External ETH transfers to dev/marketing addresses can reenter a payable entry point during _transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: from is only meaningful as an argument of _transfer and carries no independent semantics.
to is only meaningful as an argument of _transfer.
amount is only meaningful as the value argument of _transfer.
tAmount is only used to compute reflection values inside _transferStandard.
tokenAmount is only meaningful as the swap input of swapTokensForEth.
amount is only meaningful as the ETH amount distributed by sendETHToFee.
bots_ is only iterated within blockBots to update the blacklist.
notbot is only used to clear a blacklist entry in unblockBot.
maxTxAmount is only assigned into _maxTxAmount inside setMaxTxnAmount.
maxWalletSize is only assigned into _maxWalletSize inside setMaxWalletSize.
accounts is only iterated to update fee exclusions in excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees.
recipient is only forwarded from the public transfer into _transfer.
amount is only forwarded from the public transfer into _transfer.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary computed inside _transfer for the auto-swap decision.
path is a temporary array built inside swapTokensForEth for the router call.
contractETHBalance is a temporary read inside _transfer used to gate the fee distribution.
